text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am Mejiro Ardan. Once again, I look 
forward to working with you starting 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since my body isn't very strong, I worry 
that I may cause you concern at times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, I will face any hardship that 
comes my way... In order to shine in the 
"now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
